_notes.summary: The cascade generates a tag aggregate. From that aggregate, the bot derives the beat strat pool (conflict-free, tag-aligned). Within the confirmed pool, three strats are mandated at three authority tiers. Every enlisted member contributes tags to the pool through their cascade picks. The mandate derivation uses only three roles: HC level, Captain level, and Sgt level.
_notes.cascade_to_pool: Bot takes the cascade_tag_aggregate snapshot, scores each eligible stratagem against the top tags, strips conflicts (see stratagems.json conflict_map), and produces a ranked candidate list. WM confirms or vetoes the top-N pool before ops window opens.
_notes.pool_to_mandate: From the confirmed pool, bot runs three derivation passes — one per tier — each selecting the highest-scoring strat for that tier's authority tags. Mandate strats are guaranteed conflict-free with each other.
_notes.enforcement: Honor system. Members self-report strats_active in /campaign-log. Bot does not block submission. WM and Castellan can audit log entries against the published mandate. Deliberate non-compliance = narrative discipline, no mechanical block.
_notes.rank_contribution: ALL ranks contribute cascade picks that seed the pool. Only HC, Captain, and Sgt levels drive mandate derivation. Battle-line and specialist cascade picks determine WHICH strats are available — not which three are required.

theatre.label: Theatre Strat
theatre.derivation: Bot scores pool strats against the tag aggregate from ALL HC tier cascade picks. Watch Master's theatre_order tags are the primary driver (1.0x). All other HC roles contribute at 0.75x. Highest-scoring conflict-free strat is selected.
theatre.fallback_if_wm_absent: Bot selects based on the highest-frequency tags in the full cascade_tag_aggregate, unweighted.
theatre.scope: Applies to ALL enlisted members across ALL companies this beat.

company.label: Company Strat
company.derivation: Bot scores remaining pool strats (not already mandated at Theatre tier) against the tag aggregate from ALL Company tier cascade picks within that company. Watch Captain's company_order tags are the primary driver (1.0x). All other Company tier roles contribute at 0.75x. Derivation runs independently per company — different companies may mandate different company strats.
company.fallback_if_captain_absent: Bot inherits HC cascade tags at 1.0x and picks from remaining pool.
company.scope: Applies to all KTs within that Captain's company. Multiple companies may have different company strats.

kt.label: Kill Team Strat
kt.derivation:
Bot scores remaining pool strats (not already mandated at Theatre or Company tier) against the tag aggregate from ALL KT tier cascade picks within that kill team. Sgt's doctrine pick is the primary driver (1.0x) and sets the tag direction:
  - oath_of_moment → [elimination, aggressive]
  - combined_arms → [resilience, recovery]
  - duty_unto_death → [defensive, fortify]
All other KT roles' chapter tag_weights contribute at 0.75x on top of the doctrine direction.
kt.fallback_if_sgt_absent: Bot picks from remaining pool weighted by the aggregate of all KT members' chapter tag_weights, no doctrine direction applied.
kt.scope: Applies to members of that specific KT only.

stacking_rules.member_required_strats: Each member must run: [theatre_strat] + [their company_strat] + [their KT strat] = 3 required strats minimum.
stacking_rules.optional_additional: Members may self-select additional strats from the pool beyond the 3 mandated. No cap — pool is the limit.
stacking_rules.conflict_check: The three mandated strats are conflict-free by construction. If a member adds optional strats, they are responsible for checking conflicts manually. Bot will flag conflicts in /campaign-log if detected.
stacking_rules.reporting: In /campaign-log strats_active field: list all strats run that op. Bot cross-refs against published mandate for audit.

mandate_publication.timing: Published when WM confirms the strat pool (strat_pool.locked = true). Available from pool lock until end of ops window.
mandate_publication.command: /campaign-mandate (read-only view: shows all three mandated strats and their scope)
mandate_publication.stored_in: campaign_state.strat_pool — mandate strats stored as strat_pool.theatre_mandate, strat_pool.company_mandates{company_id: strat_name}, strat_pool.kt_mandates{sgt_user_id: strat_name}
